comparison: Three-job seed31 paired communication OFF/ON uses the same checkpoint, physical criteria, pose jitter and 6000-tick budget. Both finish. ON takes11 more simulation ticks; this is causal integration evidence, not evidence of performance improvement.
limitations: Task-specific behavior cloning with calibrated fixed cameras and physical color fiducials; not a foundation VLA.
